title: Reflections inside buildings can trigger false alarms
body_md: In halls, other buildings and under canopies the GPS signal can be reflected. This can severely impair the accuracy of position determination and can trigger theft reports even though the vehicle has not been moved. The source therefore recommends deactivating geofencing when the vehicle is parked in a building or under a roof.
